Along Ricci flow, \[ \partial _t riangle f= riangle (\partial _tf) +2\langle \Ric ,\Hess f angle . \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch ↗ claim:curvature-symmetries-bianchi Differentiate $g^{ij}\Hess (f)_{ij}$. Besides the two displayed terms, this produces $-g^{ij}(\partial _t\Gamma ^k_{ij})\partial _kf$. In normal coordinates,

\[ g^{ij}\partial _t\Gamma ^k_{ij} =g^{kl}g^{ij}(- abla _j\Ric _{li}- abla _i\Ric _{lj} + abla _l\Ric _{ij})=0 \]

by the contracted second Bianchi identity.
